reason: The concurrent full test suite exposed a test isolation bug: the determinism test rewrote the shared fixture corpus while report-input tests were reading JSON files, causing an intermittent truncated JSON parse. This was a verification-harness race, not a model or corpus change.
changes: The fixture determinism test copies the unchanged generator into two fresh temporary roots and compares independently generated manifests without writing the shared corpus.

Archived verification scopes revision equality to calculation and inference inputs. Test harnesses, checker code, UI code and operator documents may be amended without relabelling an earlier model execution.
The original committed model-freeze snapshot, its provenance digest, every frozen source byte and dependency version are revalidated against the original evaluated revision and current checkout.
The renderer accepts an explicit preserved source revision only after the same calculation-input and frozen-byte checks pass.
The local PostgreSQL browser harness isolates its test client identity per run while retaining persistent quotas within the run. Production API behavior is unchanged.
The README renderer adds the verified recorded GIF, an actual failed-case link and explicit supported and unsupported claim boundaries. These are presentation changes.
